title: /harness/branch/[branch]/[...at]/components/[entity]/history
responsibility: Shows the commits that changed one component, with their reasons, sizes and standing.

outputs.name: +page
outputs.description: This is the page markup rendered when the route uses HarnessScreen with EntityHistoryScreen as its content. This file delegates both the screen content and wrapper rendering, so it does not specify history records or their notices.

outputs.name: title
outputs.description: This is the fixed title string passed to HarnessScreen when the route renders. It is always Component history in this page implementation.
